column1: # Authored P_ref values (C5 §3.5): our numbers, not CCP's. Applied by
# tools/content_econ.py before the reprocess floor, so the floor still guards
# them; the bundle shows each as source = override in econ/prices.tsv. The
# server never reads this file; edit it and tools/up.sh re-extracts (the
# bundle's manifest records it as an `input`).
# type_id: a client type id. price: P_ref before the floor, above 0; a row
# replaces whatever the recipe, PI, base or parent rule derived. why: the
# Ships with no rows. Salvage is priced by C5 §3.5's tier rule in code
# (content_econ.SALVAGE_TIER_BASE), where nothing else prices it, and a row
# here wins over that rule. Faction tags, strongboxes and NPC trade items stay
# unpriced on purpose (C4 prices them through the LP rule, C5 §5.6). Example
